records.title: Proposals for Telangana Fiber grid corporation Limited.
details:
a to b): Government of Telangana has submitted a proposal for the implementation in the state, along with a request for a loan amounting to Rs. 1,779 crore from the Government of India to T-Fiber Government of Telangana.
In response, the criteria and modalities for the implementation of Amended BharatNet Program (ABP) have been communicated to the State Government and the matter is under discussion.

records.title: Zaheerabad Industrial smart city
details:
a to b: The Government of Telangana submitted the proposal for development of Zaherrabad Node as part of Hyderabad - Nagpur Industrial Corridor (HNIC) under National Industrial Corridor Development Programme (NICDP), which was approved by the Government of India (GoI) on 28th August,2024. 
(i) A special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) namely "NICDIT Zaheerabad Industrial Smart City Ltd" has been incorporated for implementation of the project. 
(ii) The release of NICDIT's equity contribution to the SPV is contingent upon inter alia the submission of land details including khasra numbers, land maps, and land valuation by the Telangana State Industrial Infrastructure Corporation Limited (TGIIC) to NICDC.

records.title: Road Infrastructure in Telangana.
details:
a to b): At present, 52 NHs projects in 1,423 km length costing
₹25,323 crore are under construction in the State of Telangana. The
Government has incurred expenditure of ₹25,000 crore
ii) Government has also taken up preparation of Detailed Project
Report for Northern Regional Ring Road of Hyderabad.

records.title: Review of IPS Cadre
details: Part (a); It was inter-alia stated that the State Government was requested vide Ministry of Home Affairs' letter dated 28.01.2021 to send the complete proposal for Cadre Review of IPS. The proposal has been received and is under active consideration in consultation with the stakeholders.

records.title: Pollution in Smaller Cities
details: अगर किसी एक विशेष शहर का कोई ऐसा मामला है, जिसमें नियमों का उल्लंघन हुआ है तो माननीय सदस्य मेरे संज्ञान में ला सकते हैं, लेकिन इसकी प्राथमिक जिम्मेदारी संघीय ढांचे के अंतर्गत स्टेट पॉल्यूशन कंट्रोल बोर्ड की है
